notes.title: Butt Slapper maintenance patch
notes.notes:
I salute you, slappers of butts. This new patch is a very small one, but comes with a few things to talk about.

Background scroll fixed in the in-game Inventory
Small dumb bug, but we got it fixed now. Sorry about that!

Drop rates website updated
The dedicated website has been finally updated with the new Butts and all their drop rates. Be sure to force it to update it by pressing Ctlr + F5. If you still can't see the new Butts, consider using incognito mode or changing browser. We'll work on this fixing inconvenience, which is a result of how the website caches its data.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204893/163b113101634e6e7246697cb13316574f0dd00c.jpg

You can find a link to it by going to the Butt Crates menu, or by clicking this Doobly-Doo.

New Slap-Support email
As part of the process of me slowly handing the development tasks to the Butt Slapper team, I have created a dedicated email account for providing support with technical issues. If you need direct communication with the team, send an email to:

[code]ButtSlapperSupport@amarillo-arts.net[/code]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204893/d4924ba80c42db71207cd76bc99b70083579bec8.png

Be sure to follow the instructions in this pinned Discussions post.

Until the next time.
- The Amarillo Spicy Corporation

notes.title: The Holidays Event update is live!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204893/3709bdcf768ab6c857843ee77327fa51c1c8ebe0.jpg

WE ARE SO BACK 🗣️🗣️

Hello peeps and poops. First of all, an apology for taking so long. I personally needed to slow the pace after a few crazy months of almost non-stop Butt development. Believe it or not, a man can get burned out of seeing butts all day.

Here's what we're bringing into the game:

A Buncha Butts
The regular Butt Crate pool gets updated with new additions:

Uncommon Butts

 Half Assed Butt
 Tanned Butt
 Shiny Butt

Rare Butts

 Office Butt
 Swimsuit Dark Butt
 Swimsuit Light Butt
 Swimsuit Tan Butt

Exquisite Butt

 Furry Butt

GYATT Butts

 Milker Butt
 Nyanners Goro

If you didn't know, Butt Slapper did get Nyatasha Nyanners banned from twitch a few weeks ago, so I decided to collab with her and add her ghostly cat pet into the game.

The new Seasonal Holidays Butt Crate (lasting until January 2025)
This new limited Crate comes with all these Butts:

Common Butts

 Thanksgiving Dark Butt
 Thanksgiving Light Butt
 Thanksgiving Tan Butt

Uncommon Butts

 Clowny Butt
 Raven Girl Butt

Rare Butts

 Brazilian Virtual Singer Butt
 Useless Mage Butt
 Fighter of Streets Butt

Exquisite Butts

 Girlpool Butt
 Jane Sue Butt
 Ada Turkey Butt
 Boba Turkey Butt
 Clara Turkey Butt

GYATT Butt

 Thanksgiving Idol Butt

I will be adding more Butts to this limited Holidays Butt Crate with Christmas and New Years Butts.

The Slap Shop
I have created a new section for the Crate Lab menu called The Slap Shop. Here you'll be able to buy different animated backgrounds for the game using your Slaps. I will also be adding more interesting backgrounds in the future!

Butt Exchange
Also in the Crate Lab, you'll find the Butt Exchange menu, where you can "sell" any Butt you want to get rid of, and get some AMACoin in return. This is great if you want to order some Holiday Butt Crates using that AMACoin!

Bye bye, Spooky Butt Crate
After almost a month since Halloween, it's past time I phased this Crate out. Now, instead of getting Spooky Butt Crates, you'll be getting Holidays Butt Crates at the same rate. If you own a bunch of Spooky Butt Crates, they will still be good to open and trade. The only thing that has changed is that there isn't a way to generate new Spooky Butt Crates anymore. At least until the next Halloween event comes!

New save system
We worked on yet another new save system. As I, Amarillo, am not a great programmer, the new Butt Slapper team worked on this. I sincerely hope this brings to an end the repeated issues people with unstable power sources have been having all this time.

New original soundtrack
My buddy Mutante Robot composed a few original tracks for the game. These are stream-friendly (even if the game isn't so too much), so fear no copyright claims. While Mutante made 99% of the music, I did personally step in to play the bass lines.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204893/509734556236860b9b5c4701e1db09e724fec69a.png

That's it for now! Little by little the development of Butt Slapper will be handed to the yet-to-be-named Game Studio of the friend I have partnered with. I will keep working on the Butts and art, but the code and maintenance will be in better hands.

I'm sorry to all the people that have been experiencing problems with the saves!

See you around. Don't forget that you can always join my Discord and reach out to me (or my mods) directly if there's anything you need help with.

- The Amarillo Spicy Corporation

notes.title: Butt Slapper maintenance patch
notes.notes:
My slappers, I've listened to your feedback so I have modified the drop rates of the Spooky Butt Crate to be now 100% guaranteed to get you a Spooky Butt. My hope is that this will help the event feel a little more fair, while trying to minimize the impact on the market.

As always, you can check the current drop rates in the website. Be sure to force an update with Ctrl + F5.

notes.title: Butt Slapper Maintenance patch
notes.notes:
Few tweaks:


The game will now only check for drops in the Slapping screen, and no longer in the Main Menu
Added a new achievement. When reaching 10 million Slaps, a magic button will appear in the Upgrades Menu, which will delete all your progress (Slaps and Upgrades only) in exchange for a new achievement
Butt Crate drop rate temporarily reduced back to 5 per day

About the Crate drops
It seems like our Community Market has been taken over by bots recently, due to the game's popularity. I'm going to take measures to try to fix the economy by introducing new ways to use your Butt Crates in a coming update. I will be tweaking the drop rates to try to minimize the negative effect of the bots in the market.

Thank you for your service to the slapper community.

- The Amarillo Spicy Corporation

notes.title: Butt Slapper Maintenance patch
notes.notes:
What is taking place fellow mice destroyers?

This is what's new:


Added an optional frame rate limiter option in the Settings menu. This should help with excesive GPU usage for some.
Fixed an issue with the way hands were being animated which was producing some strange behaviors for a number of players.
Fixed a few small bugs like in-game inventories not updating properly after selling/buying Steam Inventory Items.

But there's one more thing. I removed two Butts from the pool:


Butt Naked Butt
Thong Butt

These were originally part of the fist prototype of the game, so they have a few quirks to them that I don't like. However, if you already own those, worry not because you'll keep them for as long as you want in your Steam Inventory.

Thank you so much for Slapping Butt all day! You'll be hearing from me again ːsteamsunnyː

- The Amarillo Spicy Corporation
